title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 22 September 2026
description: Today: Australia posts 1.2 million new jobs over four years with unemployment at a 50-year low; Queensland Rail and seven unions settle a nine-month pay dispute with full services returning by November; and the Gold Coast confirms a $226 million investment in sport and community facilities. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
